description: Choose the Claude Code account of a pane: `global` follows the global account (and moves with it), an account id pins the pane there. When Claude Code runs on another account (which must be signed in), it moves: it stops and starts again there, resuming its conversation (copied to that account if it doesn't share conversations). An idle pane moves now (looked at again right before it stops); one that is working or waiting moves once its turn ends (`after_turn`). Choosing the account it already runs on changes no process, and cancels a move that waits (`cancelled`).

account.description: `global` (follow the global account) or an account id (pin to it).

oneOf.description: It follows the global account, which it already runs on (or Claude Code is not running).
It is pinned to the account it already runs on (or Claude Code is not running).
Claude Code was idle and now runs on the account.
Claude Code is working or waiting: it moves once its turn ends.
A move that waited for the turn was called off.

account.description: The account it runs on now, or will after its turn.
